note: Operated by the Village of La Farge, in the wooded village park on West Adams St at the north end of this Kickapoo River town, with three picnic shelters and a playground. Sites are smaller (won't fit a 40-ft motorhome with slides) but accommodate a 23-ft rig. --Claude
